skills/accessibility-audit/SKILL.md.name: Accessibility check

skills/browser-test-hygiene/SKILL.md.name: Reliable browser tests
skills/browser-test-hygiene/SKILL.md.description: Gives rules for writing automatic browser tests that give the same result every time, without fixed waits or shared data.

skills/persona-walkthrough/SKILL.md.description: Has an AI assistant play a defined buyer scrolling a website or signup flow, to find what confuses or turns them away before publishing.

skills/slopbuster-audit/references/outpu.description: Defines how audit results are laid out: a scores file, an overview, a fix plan and one note per category.

skills/slopbuster-audit/references/pytho.name: Python server review checklist
skills/slopbuster-audit/references/pytho.description: Gives the criteria for reviewing a Python server: structure, handling slow or failing outside services, security and monitoring.

skills/slopbuster-audit/references/repo-.name: Whole-project audit guide
skills/slopbuster-audit/references/repo-.description: Explains what to look for when auditing every file of a project, changed or not, for sloppy or fake code.

skills/slopbuster-audit/references/rust-.name: Rust server review checklist
skills/slopbuster-audit/references/rust-.description: Gives the criteria for reviewing a Rust server: requests, background tasks, resource limits, security and monitoring.

skills/slopbuster-audit/references/simul.name: User journey simulation
skills/slopbuster-audit/references/simul.description: Explains how to role-play a real user step by step through each flow to find problems that reading code would miss.

skills/slopbuster-audit/SKILL.md.name: Code quality audit
skills/slopbuster-audit/SKILL.md.description: Guides an AI assistant to audit a project or change for AI-written filler, fake code, duplication and technical debt.

skills/ui-finish-gate/SKILL.md.name: Screen release gate
